current.zh-CN: 当前步骤，从 0 开始计数；`dataSource` 项可用 status 覆盖状态。不可绑定，更新由使用方在 `onChange` 里写。
current.en-US: Current step, counting from 0; a `dataSource` item can override the state with status. Not bindable: update it yourself in `onChange`.

dataSource.zh-CN: 步骤数据，每项为 `StepData`：`status`（该步骤自己的状态，缺省时随 current 与 status 自动决定）、`title`、`description`（nav 类型不渲染）、`icon`（该步骤自定义图标的 snippet，`false` 不显示图标，缺省用状态图标；nav 类型不渲染）、`onClick`（设置后该步骤可点击）、`classNames` 与 `styles`（该步骤内部各部位的类名与样式字符串，键为 `icon`、`content`、`title`、`description`，写法同 Steps 的同名属性，追加在组件自带的类名与 Steps 的 `item*` 之后；`icon` 在 basic 类型是前置的状态图标或序号、在 nav 类型是尾部的箭头，`description` 仅 basic 类型渲染），其余属性落在步骤根元素上。
dataSource.en-US: Step data. Each item is a `StepData`: `status` (own status of the step; when omitted it follows current and status), `title`, `description` (not rendered by the nav type), `icon` (snippet for a custom icon of that step; `false` shows no icon; the status icon is used when omitted; not rendered by the nav type) `onClick` (setting it makes that step clickable), and `classNames` and `styles` (class names and style strings of the inner parts of that step, keyed by `icon`, `content`, `title` and `description`, written like the props of Steps with the same names and appended after the built-in classes and the `item*` classes of Steps; `icon` is the leading status icon or number in the basic type and the trailing arrow in the nav type, and `description` is rendered by the basic type only). Other attributes land on the step's root element.

description.zh-CN: 每个步骤详情描述的 snippet，参数 `{ item, index }`；缺省时显示 `item.description`。nav 类型不渲染。
description.en-US: Snippet for the description of each step, with `{ item, index }`; defaults to `item.description`. Not rendered by the nav type.

hasLine.zh-CN: basic 类型是否显示连接线。
hasLine.en-US: Whether the basic type shows connecting lines.

initial.zh-CN: 起始序号，从 0 开始计数。

onChange.zh-CN: 点击或键盘选择步骤时调用，参数为该步骤序号（initial 加索引）；点击当前步骤不调用。传入后所有步骤变为可点击。
onChange.en-US: Called when a step is selected by click or keyboard, with its number (initial plus index); not called for the current step. Passing it makes every step clickable.

size.zh-CN: basic 与 nav 类型的尺寸，可选 default、small。
size.en-US: Size of the basic and nav types: default or small.

status.zh-CN: 当前步骤的状态，可选 wait、process、finish、error、warning。
status.en-US: State of the current step: wait, process, finish, error or warning.

title.zh-CN: 每个步骤标题的 snippet，参数 `{ item, index }`；缺省时显示 `item.title`。
title.en-US: Snippet for the title of each step, with `{ item, index }`; defaults to `item.title`.

classNames.zh-CN: 内部各部位的类名，键为 item、itemIcon、itemContent、itemTitle、itemDescription，值的写法同 class（字符串、数组或对象），与组件自带的类名合并。键作用到每个步骤：item 是步骤的根元素，itemIcon 在 basic 类型是前置的状态图标或序号、在 nav 类型是尾部的箭头，itemDescription 仅 basic 类型渲染。
classNames.en-US: Class names of the inner parts, keyed by item, itemIcon, itemContent, itemTitle and itemDescription; values take anything class takes (string, array or object) and merge with the built-in classes. Keys apply to every step: item is the step's root element, itemIcon is the leading status icon or number in the basic type and the trailing arrow in the nav type, and itemDescription is rendered by the basic type only.

styles.zh-CN: 内部各部位的样式字符串，键同 classNames。
styles.en-US: Style strings of the inner parts, keyed like classNames.

type.zh-CN: 步骤条类型，可选 basic、nav，未设置时为 basic。
type.en-US: Steps type: basic or nav, defaults to basic.
